Triage → `domain:devx` · p2 · dependencies.

**Anchoring.** The two edits land in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and a changeset, and the gate that refuses the current state is `scripts/check-override-consistency.mjs` ⇒ `scripts/` (gate class, code-quality subject) ⇒ `domain:devx`. The nine published packages the changeset touches span five lanes; ⛔ none of them is the fix site, so this does not become a cross-domain card.

**Grade p2.** The substantive blocker is a genuine **tested ≠ shipped** divergence — every green suite on PR #13589 ran `@better-auth/scim` **1.7.1** (the workspace override wins) while the published manifest ships **1.7.2** to downstream installs. That is a real correctness gap, correctly caught by the gate, on a security-relevant package. Not p1: nothing is broken in a shipped release today, the PR simply cannot land until it is fixed, and the security posture is unchanged (GHSA-j8v8-g9cx-5qf4 is patched in >=1.7.0-beta.4, so 1.7.2 stays patched).

**The card's central observation is the part to carry into the dispatch order**, because it is what makes this a two-line fix rather than an argument:

> the override's documented reason for the EXACT pin — `^1.7.1` would resolve to 1.7.2 *"whose `better-auth`/`@better-auth/core` peers at `^1.7.2` these overrides would silence rather than satisfy"* — **is dissolved by this very PR**, since the whole better-auth family moves to 1.7.2 in lockstep.

So the override sync is not a weakening dressed as a bump; the stated precondition for the pin genuinely stopped being true. The dev must **update the comment block's now-stale sentences**, not just the version string — leaving the old rationale in place is how the next reader re-pins it.

**⛔ Prohibitions, all four carried from the card and all four load-bearing:**

- ⛔ **Never force-push or rebase the dependabot branch.** Additive commits only — a rebase discards them.
- ⛔ This is a **version sync, not an override weakening**. Keep the exact-pin shape.
- ⛔ Adopting the family float (`^1.7.2`) is the **separate follow-up** the comment block already names. Not this card.
- ⛔ devDependency-only and private-app changes get **no changeset entry** (the #9212 convention); verify the published-package list against the actual diff rather than pasting the card's list.

⚠️ **The re-run is the real reading, and a red there is a finding, not a flake.** After the lockfile re-resolves, CI tests scim **1.7.2 for the first time**. If the SCIM parity/model gates flag wire drift, that is the whole point of the gate having refused — report it, do not re-run to green. #11632 (SCIM epic, open) is the context to read before judging such a failure.

**Precedent** #9297 / #9212 gives the changeset shape; follow it rather than inventing one.

## ⚠️ Target moved — this card names a CLOSED PR and a DELETED branch. Substance is live; ⛔ not dispatchable as written.

`domain:devx` PM seat (#6023) at card selection. ⛔ Not a re-grading and ⛔ not a dispute with the director seat's evaluation — recording a state change so the next reader does not dispatch a dev at a branch that no longer exists.

### Measured just now

| reading | value |
| :--- | :--- |
| **PR #13589** | **CLOSED, ⛔ not merged** — by `os-sam` at **2026-08-31T14:46:58Z** |
| its branch `dependabot/npm_and_yarn/production-dependencies-6f36c788ab` | **DELETED** by `dependabot[bot]` at 14:47:07Z |
| successor | ⭐ **PR #13887** is open — `dependabot/npm_and_yarn/production-dependencies-ff543f966b`, the same production-dependencies group, same "21 updates" |
| `pnpm-workspace.yaml:179` on `origin/main` | still `'@better-auth/scim@<2.0.0': '1.7.1'` |

⇒ **the defect this card records is untouched** — the override still pins `1.7.1`, so the tested≠shipped divergence will recur the moment the group PR bumps the manifest to `1.7.2` again. ⛔ But every instruction in the card points at a branch that no longer exists: *"Fix (minimal, on the PR branch)"*, *"Never force-push or rebase a dependabot branch"*, the `pnpm-workspace.yaml:179` line number, the file list the changeset is to be derived from.

### Why this seat is not simply re-pointing it at #13887 and dispatching

⛔ **The blockers must be re-derived on the new PR, ⛔ not assumed to carry over.** #13887 is freshly opened; its own checks may not have run yet, and its file list — which the changeset's package list is derived from — is a **different diff** even if the group name matches. A dispatch that carried the old file list forward would author a changeset against a diff nobody read.

⇒ left in `pm:queue`, ⛔ unassigned, with this comment as the re-target record. It becomes dispatchable as soon as #13887's checks have run and the two blockers are confirmed present on it — at which point the card's fix shape almost certainly transfers unchanged, because the override on `main` has not moved.

⚠️ **The `⛔ never rebase a dependabot branch` warning in the card is worth keeping regardless of which PR it lands on** — it is the reason the additive-commit shape is mandatory, and #13589's branch being deleted the instant it closed is a live demonstration of how little of that branch survives an outside action.

The successor carrying the same bumps is **#13887** (`chore(deps): Bump the production-dependencies group with 21 updates`, open). ⛔ Do not dispatch against #13589 — it points at a branch that no longer exists.

⭐ **Premise re-verified on `origin/main` before claiming, ⛔ not taken from the card:**
- the pin is **not** in root `package.json` (there is no `overrides` block there at all) — it is `pnpm-workspace.yaml:179`, `'@better-auth/scim@<2.0.0': '1.7.1'`;
- `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/package.json:29` declares `"@better-auth/scim": "1.7.1"`;
- #13887 moves the whole better-auth family **1.7.1 → 1.7.2** and ⛔ touches no override.

⇒ the defect is live and the card stands.

⚠️ Half-state repaired in the same write: this card had been carrying `pm:queue` while a check-in note treated it as held. 等待写在卡上才存在 — the note was in session state, not on the card, so the card was telling the truth and the note was not. It is now `pm:dispatched`.

**Closed by PR #13938**, merged 2026-08-31T18:41:57Z. `pm:dispatched` stripped by hand — 关闭即摘 `pm:*`.

⚠️ The card's stated target (#13589) was dead — closed unmerged, branch deleted — and the work was re-pointed at its successor **#13887**, with the affected list derived from that PR's own diff rather than carried forward.

⭐ **The sharpest measurement in this card**: on `origin/main`'s exact pin, #13887's ask **installs with exit 0**, says nothing about better-auth, resolves `@better-auth/scim@1.7.1` beside `better-auth@1.7.2`, and **rewrites the recorded importer specifier from the declared `1.7.2` DOWN to `1.7.1`**. The split family is silent at the install layer; only `check:override-consistency` catches it. ⇒ That is the #3653 ruling's *"silence rather than satisfy"* shape running in the **opposite direction** — the pin written to prevent a silent downgrade had begun causing one.

All eleven family members moved in step (`^1.7.2`), scim rejoined the family shape, and the now-false rationale was **rewritten, not deleted**, keeping the half of the ruling that survives: *"the whole family still moves as ONE line, and a bump that moves scim alone is still the mistake the ruling named."*

⛔ My Zone 2 C — *"nothing published changes"* — was **falsified**: `@objectstack/plugin-auth` is published and five of its declared ranges moved, which is exactly what a downstream install resolves. A patch changeset was owed and written.

Residual filed as **#13940** (95 stale `1.7.1` version stamps across 56 files; hand-swept three times before, population grown 29 → 95).
